about: What money bail costs a defendant where the law in force sets it. Read by src/simulation/justice/pretrial.ts. bail2009Dollars is the median bail set for felony defendants in the 75 largest counties in 2009 by the most serious charge; vandalism reads the 'other property' row and a campaign's money spent on oneself reads the 'fraud' row; any other offense reads 'default', the all-offenses median. The court's bail is that amount in 2025 dollars by the CPI-U annual averages. toGoHome is what a defendant must pay to go home on that bail, as a share of it: ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE, the one rule read so far, until research reads each place's deposit rule or regulated bond premium. Nothing here is shown to a player.
